# Which files GitHub says a CODEOWNERS line owns, one per line:
#
#   <CODEOWNERS line> | <file path> | <1 if the line owns the file, else 0>
#
# Recorded on 2026-10-31 from a private test repository, with one branch per
# CODEOWNERS file, by reading `codeownerInfo.ruleForPathLine` from GitHub's
# `/{owner}/{repo}/deferred-metadata/{branch}/{path}` endpoint. Each line was
# the only rule in its CODEOWNERS file. Lines GitHub's errors API rejects own
# nothing, so they're recorded as 0.
